translations.web: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.
translations.bsb: There is a grievous evil I have seen under the sun: wealth hoarded to the harm of its owner,
translations.kjv: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun, namely, riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.
